d:
Bihar ke navada jile men svasthy vibhag aur jila prashasan ki vyavastha par ganbhir saval khare karne vali ek ghatna samne aaee hai. maut ke bad bhi sarkari enbulens uplabdh nahin karae jane se naraj mritak ke parijnon ne prajatantr chauk ko jam kar jamkar hangama kiya. sarak jam hone ke karan shahar men aavagman bhi kaphi der tak prabhavit raha.
Traiktar ki chapet men aane se huee thi maut, ee-riksha par shav lekar sadar aspatal pahunche parijan
